newsitem.title: CANADA: Minorca Resources appoints new president.
newsitem.headline: Minorca Resources appoints new president.

text.p: Minorca Resources Inc said on Tuesday it has appointed a new president and chief executive officer.
The board has hired Roland Horst for the positions, effective immediately, the company said in a release.
Horst has 20 years of senior executive experience, most recently at brokerage Richardson Greenshields, the company said.
Horst replaces Hermann Derbuch, who has filled the president and chief operating officer roles until now, a company spokeswoman said.
Derbuch will stay on as acting chief operating officer for now, she said.
The chief executive position had been filled on a temporary basis by Minroca chairman Alfred Lenarciak.
